definition.zh-TW: 營業利益占營業收入的比例，看本業扣掉銷管費用後還剩多少。數值越高表示本業的獲利能力越強。
definition.en: Operating profit as a share of revenue: what is left of the core business after distribution and administrative expenses. Higher means a more profitable core business.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
